narrative_markdown:
## Today's Forecast

Much like yesterday. Dry by day, with thunder possible, peaking overnight. 32°C (89°F) high, 20°C (68°F) low. Sky clear early as reported, partly cloudy at midday and partly cloudy in the evening. Wind NNE early and SW at midday; gusts to 35 km/h (19 kt). UV index 8.8 (very high). Air quality 72 (moderate), by the CAMS model. As of 06:02, reports through 05:30: no rain; no thunder; high so far 22°C (72°F); low so far 19°C (66°F); peak sustained 9 km/h (5 kt); sky clear.

## Extended Outlook

Temperatures and winds much the same through Sunday, with thunderstorms likely each day. Skies partly cloudy throughout. Sunday's call: dry, 0%, with no model wet; highs around 32°C (90°F). Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) calls it dry. At this lead ECMWF has the best record, right 93% of the time over 99 checks.

Further out, temperatures and winds much the same through Thursday, with thunderstorms likely Monday, thunderstorms possible Tuesday, showers and thunderstorms possible Wednesday, and showers possible Thursday. Monday: no model wet, highs 31 to 34°C (88 to 93°F). Tuesday: one of four models wet, highs around 33°C (91°F), thunder possible rather than likely. Wednesday: one of three models wet, highs around 33°C (92°F).

Only GFS, ECMWF and ICON reach past Tuesday. Thursday's call: rain, 59%, with one of two models wet; highs around 32°C (89°F). At this lead ECMWF has the best record, right 93% of the time over 95 checks.

## Severe Weather / Hazard Potential

Convective instability in the hours ahead: ECMWF 2780 J/kg, UKMO 1940 J/kg, ICON 1640 J/kg and GFS 740 J/kg. Thunder likely; any thunderstorm brings sudden gusts well above the 35 km/h (19 kt) forecast.

## Winam Gulf — Conditions for Boaters

Peak gust 29 km/h (16 kt). Any thunderstorm brings sudden gusts well above this figure; the water is unsafe while one is nearby.

## Detailed Discussion

### Synoptic Overview

Across roughly 2,600 km, pressure is lowest toward the west (1009 hPa) and highest toward the northeast (1016 hPa) — a 6 hPa spread, a moderate large-scale gradient. The lower pressure to the west is filling over the next three days. Pressure overhead is near-steady. Sampling is a nine-point ring at 12-degree spacing, so this locates a direction, not a centre or a front. Across the basin's 5 points, pressure today sits between 1012.8 and 1015.2 hPa, near-steady over three days (-0.8 hPa). Pressure here over the last 24 hours: -0.1 hPa.

### Forecaster Confidence Notes

On rain the record ranks ECMWF first at Day+3, right 93% of the last 30 checks and ECMWF first at Day+7, right 93% of the last 30 checks. On today's high GFS is the warmest model at 31.2°C (88.2°F) and ICON the coolest at 30.0°C (86.0°F); the call's 31.6°C (88.9°F) sits at the warm end. Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) calls a high of 31.0°C (87.8°F) and rain, against the call on rain. At Day+0, no model is meaningfully better than the others here yet. At Day+3, ECMWF is the strongest rain caller here and kenya_met the weakest. At Day+7, ECMWF is the strongest rain caller here and GFS the weakest.

Figures issued 06:02. Written by code; a discussion follows when a model answers.
